Is E20 petrol really the future of India—or are we rushing into a policy with unanswered questions?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu break down the truth behind India's ethanol blending program. Does E20 reduce fuel imports and pollution? Can it affect the mileage, performance, or longevity of older vehicles? Why are some experts supporting it while many vehicle owners remain concerned? Most importantly, is India solving one problem while creating another?
